en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad European boulevard with tram tracks, horse‑drawn carriages, pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing, and multi‑story buildings along both sides. A clock‑towered building dominates the left foreground, while a large monument or fountain stands on the right in the middle of the square. The image caption in red script at the bottom reads "Dresden-N. Hauptstrasse." Additional small printing appears along the lower left edge.
